Text reads 'Haier'. Composite image showing Haier brand logo on left, followed by interior home scenes including potted plant, modern refrigerator with glass doors displaying beverages and food items, and minimalist kitchen appliances.

Text reads "EBS 3D" and "Raffreddamento flessibile, pensato per ogni giorno". Side-by-side refrigerator with open doors displaying interior shelving, storage compartments, and fresh food items in a modern kitchen setting with minimalist décor.

Text reads 'CARATTERISTICHE PRINCIPALI' with six feature icons: Brain with berries labeled 'Aiuta nella formazione di placche'; Leaf labeled 'Assorbimento e flusso d'aria uniforme per conservare la freschezza di alimenti'; Dark leafy greens labeled 'Ideale per frutta e verdura'; Food containers labeled 'Sistema Temperatura ideale per ogni tipo di alimento'; Red warning icon labeled 'Protezione antibatterica avanzata'; Refrigerator interior labeled 'Massima visibilità in ogni angolo'. Product feature comparison display.

Text reads "CUBE". Four-panel modular display unit with numbered sections 1-4, each featuring rounded rectangle screens with blue borders and gray backgrounds. Section 1 shows a small cylindrical object.
Prime

Text reads 'FRENCH DOOR'. Diagram showing a French door configuration with four numbered panels: panels 1 and 2 side-by-side at top, panel 3 in middle, panel 4 at bottom. Blue frame outlines indicate glass panes arrangement.

Text reads 'Meno sprechi, più efficienza' and 'Accedi al tuo frigorifero in modo pratico e senza i consumi. IFS a 30%'. Image shows open refrigerator drawer with organized compartments containing food items and storage containers.
Text reads 'SIDE BY SIDE'. Illustration of two tall refrigerators positioned side-by-side, labeled '1' and '2', with unit 2 featuring an ice/water dispenser on the door.
Prime
Text reads '3D'. Three-panel 3D interface mockup showing numbered screens labeled 1, 2, and 3 stacked vertically with blue borders and gray backgrounds.
Prime

Text reads "Acqua fresca, subito" with Italian subtitle "Drink towards 'frische' acqua per le temperature elevate i nostri gesti di energia". Image shows hand holding a white beverage dispenser against black and gray modern wall panel.
Text reads '2D'. Two vertically stacked rectangular cards with rounded corners and blue borders, numbered '1' and '2' in white text on gray backgrounds, connected by a black hinge mechanism.
Text reads "MONOPORTA". Sleek vertical rectangular device with gradient blue border, minimalist design, large centered numeral "1", small rectangular element at top, light gray background.
Text reads "CONGELATORI" and "ACQUISTA TUTTI I PRODOTTI". White upright freezer with stainless steel finish, vertical handle, and compact rectangular design for food storage.
Text reads "CANTINE" and "ACQUISTA TUTTI I PRODOTTI". Black wine cooler/refrigerator with multiple shelves displaying wine bottles, featuring glass door and illuminated interior display.
